local categories={Gameplay={"AutoSprint"},Camera={"FieldOfView","WeaponFOVScale","FirstPerson","ShiftLock","Shoulder","CameraMotion"},Aim={"LookSensitivity","AimSensitivity","AimAssist","AimAssistStrength","AimAssistSlowdown","AimAssistTracking","AimAssistCentering"},Analog={"LeftStickDeadzone","RightStickDeadzone","StickCurve","StickCurveStrength"},Audio={"MenuVolume","MenuSFXVolume","GameSFXVolume","BeastProximityVolume"},Accessibility={"FontScale","HighContrast","ReducedMenuMotion","SimpleAnimations","WeaponAnimationIntensity","FOVTransitionSpeed","DamageFlash"},Interface={"MenuScale","HUDScale","KillFeedVisible"}}
categories.Reticle={"ReticleColor","ReticleSize","ReticleThickness","ReticleGap","ReticleDot","ReticleOutline","ReticleOpacity","ReticleDynamic"}

for _,entry in {{"Gameplay","GERAL"},{"Camera","CÂMERA"},{"Aim","MIRA"},{"Reticle","RETÍCULO"},{"Analog","ANALÓGICOS"},{"Interface","INTERFACE"},{"Audio","ÁUDIO"},{"Graphics","GRÁFICOS"},{"Accessibility","ACESSIBILIDADE"}} do table.insert(Settings.Groups,{Label=entry[2],Keys=categories[entry[1]]}) end
for category,keys in categories do for _,key in keys do Settings.Rules[key].Category=category end end
for key,rule in Settings.Rules do
 rule.Id=key rule.Category=rule.Category or (rule.MobileLayout and "Touch" or rule.Device and "Bindings" or "Gameplay")
 rule.PreferenceDevice=rule.Device or rule.MobileLayout and "Touch" or table.find(categories.Analog,key) and "Gamepad" or key=="AutoSprint" and "Touch" or nil
 rule.Scope=rule.PreferenceDevice and "Device" or rule.ModeOverride and "Global+Mode" or "Global"
 rule.Type=rule.Device and "binding" or rule.Choices and "choice" or typeof(rule.Default)=="boolean" and "boolean" or "number"
 rule.Modes=rule.ModeOverride and {"ctf","arena"} or nil rule.Local=true rule.Experimental=false
 rule.Persistent=true rule.Apply="Setting"..key
end
function Settings:Allows(key,scope)
 local rule=self.Rules[key] if not rule then return false end
 if rule.PreferenceDevice then return scope=="Device:"..rule.PreferenceDevice end
 return scope=="Global" or rule.ModeOverride and (scope=="Mode:ctf" or scope=="Mode:arena") or false
end
function Settings:PreferenceAttribute(key,scope)
 return "Preference"..scope:gsub(":","")..key
end
function Settings:Sanitize(key,value)
 local rule=self.Rules[key] if not rule then return end
 if rule.Device then return Controls:IsAllowed(rule.Device,value,rule.Action) and value or nil end
 if typeof(rule.Default)=="boolean" then if typeof(value)=="boolean" then return value end return end
 if typeof(value)~="number" or value~=value or math.abs(value)==math.huge then return end
 if rule.Choices then return table.find(rule.Choices,value) and value or nil end
 return math.clamp(math.round((value-rule.Min)/rule.Step)*rule.Step+rule.Min,rule.Min,rule.Max)
end
function Settings:Format(key,value)
 local r=self.Rules[key] if r.Labels then return r.Labels[value] or tostring(value) end
 if typeof(value)=="boolean" then return value and "LIGADO" or "DESLIGADO" end
 if r.Percent or key=="MenuVolume" or key=="DamageFlash" or key=="CameraMotion" then return string.format("%d%%",value*100) end
 if key=="FieldOfView" then return string.format("%d°",value) end
 return string.format("%.2f",value)
end
return Settings

local semantic={Blue=true,Red=true,Health=true,HealthBar=true,StaminaBar=true,DamageTint=true,HealthFill=true,StaminaFill=true,rank=true}
local function refreshPalette()
 local color=Catalog.Resolve(player:GetAttribute('SettingThemePreset') or 1,player:GetAttribute('SettingAccentHue'),player:GetAttribute('SettingAccentSaturation'),player:GetAttribute('SettingAccentValue'),player:GetAttribute('ThemeCustomAllowed'))
 palette=Catalog.Palette(color,player:GetAttribute('SettingHighContrast')==true)
end
refreshPalette()
function Theme.Color() return palette.Accent end
function Theme.Palette() return palette end
function Theme.Role(object,property,role)
 object:SetAttribute('ThemeRole_'..property,role) object[property]=palette[role] Theme.Apply(object)
end
local function preserved(o)
 local a=o
 while a and not a:IsA('ScreenGui') do
  if a:GetAttribute('ThemePreserve') or semantic[a.Name] or a.Name:match('^Rank%d+$') then return true end
  a=a.Parent
 end
 return false
end
local function roleOf(value)
 for _,role in {'Accent','Surface','Card','Button','Selected','Text','Muted','Track','Border','Focus'} do if value==palette[role] then return role end end
end
local function update(object,key,r)
 if not object.Parent then return end
 writing[object]=true
 local role=object:GetAttribute('ThemeRole_'..key) or r.role
 local color=role and palette[role] or Catalog.Tint(r.base,palette.RawAccent)
 r.output=color if object[key]~=color then object[key]=color end writing[object]=nil
end
function Theme.Apply(o)
 if preserved(o) then return end
 local properties=o:IsA('UIStroke') and {'Color'} or o:IsA('GuiObject') and {'BackgroundColor3','TextColor3','ImageColor3'} or {}
 local set=records[o]
 if not set then set={} records[o]=set end
 for _,key in properties do
  local ok,value=pcall(function()return o[key]end)
  if ok then
   local r=set[key]
   if not r then
    r={base=value,role=roleOf(value)} set[key]=r
    o:GetPropertyChangedSignal(key):Connect(function()
     if writing[o] or not o.Parent then return end
     local current=o[key] if current==r.output then return end
     r.base=current r.role=roleOf(current) update(o,key,r)
    end)
   end
   update(o,key,r)
  end
 end
end
function Theme.Bind(root)
 if bound[root] then return end bound[root]=true
 local connections={}
 for _,o in root:GetDescendants() do Theme.Apply(o) end
 table.insert(connections,root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)task.defer(function()if o.Parent then Theme.Apply(o)end end)end))
 table.insert(connections,Theme.Changed:Connect(function()for _,o in root:GetDescendants()do Theme.Apply(o)end end))
 root.Destroying:Once(function()for _,c in connections do c:Disconnect()end end)
end
local queued=false
local function schedule()if queued then return end queued=true task.defer(function()queued=false refreshPalette()signal:Fire()end)end
for _,key in {'ThemePreset','AccentHue','AccentSaturation','AccentValue','HighContrast'} do
 player:GetAttributeChangedSignal('Setting'..key):Connect(schedule)
end
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal('ThemeCustomAllowed'):Connect(schedule)
return Theme

local healthConnections={} local boundHumanoid
local function refreshHealth()

end
local function bindHealth(character)

 local function attach(h)
  if not h:IsA("Humanoid") or player.Character~=character then return end
  boundHumanoid=h
  table.insert(healthConnections,h.HealthChanged:Connect(refreshHealth))
  table.insert(healthConnections,h:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxHealth"):Connect(refreshHealth))
  refreshHealth()
 end

  local h=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if h then attach(h) end
  table.insert(healthConnections,character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child) if not boundHumanoid then attach(child) end end))
 end

end
